name: PositionController
description: Hydraulic axis position controller (PI + velocity damping + saturation & anti-windup).

outputs.name: valve_cmd
outputs.description: Normalized valve command to spool actuator

outputs.name: sat_flag
outputs.description: True when command is saturated (for diagnostics)

parameters.name: Kp
parameters.description: Proportional gain in normalized valve command per meter

parameters.name: integrator_limit
parameters.description: Clamp for integrator state to prevent runaway

parameters.name: deadband_m
parameters.description: Small error deadband to reduce chatter
